title: Frozen ice room — bulletin service measures

source.manualTitle: Samsung French Door Direct Cool Ice Maker Frozen (ASC20170602002)
source.oemTestTitle: RTV seal, water line, auger, route, bucket, Y-clip kit, ice maker

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug refrigerator before removing ice maker or sealing ice room. After ice maker removal, keep unit unplugged so cooling loop does not frost during service.
steps.sourceExcerpt: When the ice maker is removed, unplug the refrigerator to ensure the cooling loop does not frost over during service.

steps.title: Seal ice room with RTV
steps.body: Apply Samsung RTV sealant (DA81-05595A) along housing-to-liner joints (45° applicator tip). Seal all gaps between ice room housing and liner wall.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Apply Samsung RTV sealant (DA81-05595A) along housing-to-liner joints (45° applicator tip). Seal all gaps between ice room housing and liner wall.

steps.title: Adjust water fill line
steps.body: From rear, press grey retainer ring and back fill hose out ~10 mm. Re-inspect with mirror — line must not protrude too far into fill area. Re-secure hoses flush on rear cabinet.
steps.sourceExcerpt: From rear, press grey retainer ring and back fill hose out ~10 mm. Re-inspect with mirror — line must not protrude too far into fill area. Re-secure hoses flush on rear cabinet.

steps.title: Auger motor styrofoam
steps.body: Inspect auger motor assembly for leftover styrofoam packing blocking ice room fan airflow.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect auger motor assembly for leftover styrofoam packing blocking ice room fan airflow.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Remove styrofoam packing from auger fan.

steps.title: Ice route flapper seal
steps.body: Inspect ice route flapper — rubber pliable, no tears, fully closed. Pour water in chute: no leak at dispenser = good seal.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect ice route flapper — rubber pliable, no tears, fully closed. Pour water in chute: no leak at dispenser = good seal.

steps.title: Ice bucket gasket
steps.body: Inspect bucket for base cracks and gasket rips/rigidity preventing seal. Replace ice bucket if defective.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect bucket for base cracks and gasket rips/rigidity preventing seal. Replace ice bucket if defective.

steps.title: Install Y-clip service kit
steps.body: Replace cooling-loop retainer with kit part. Install both Y-clips on cooling loop pressed firmly against insulation — clips pointing straight down.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Replace cooling-loop retainer with kit part. Install both Y-clips on cooling loop pressed firmly against insulation — clips pointing straight down.

steps.title: Replace ice maker
steps.body: Replace ice maker assembly per bulletin model chart. After install, verify Y-clips still point straight down.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Replace ice maker assembly per bulletin model chart. After install, verify Y-clips still point straight down.

steps.title: Verify ice maker operation
steps.body: Reapply power. Confirm ice maker harvest/fill and no frost recurrence after 24–48 h.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reapply power. Confirm ice maker harvest/fill and no frost recurrence after 24–48 h.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Recheck seals, Y-clips, and water line; escalate to Samsung ASC if frost returns.

steps.title: Service complete
steps.oemOutcome: Bulletin service measures completed — ice maker replaced and verified.

steps.title: Clear auger blockage
steps.oemOutcome: Remove styrofoam from auger fan assembly.
